name: Ricardo Alonso
bio: Ricardo's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood summers spent watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in aerospace engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, and quickly landed a junior role at a small racing outfit upon graduation. His meticulous nature and sharp analytical skills led him to excel in wind tunnel operations, where he developed a keen eye for spotting subtle aerodynamic inefficiencies. He joined Carlin Academy two years ago, bringing a fresh perspective and a proactive approach to optimizing vehicle performance. Ricardo is known for his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the engineers, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean, athletic build, and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas during wind tunnel runs.
Has a habit of humming quietly while analyzing data.
Insists on listening to classical music while calibrating the wind tunnel.
